messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: REAL-TIME ALERT: streaming.response.p99 breached threshold. current=2.85s baseline=0.95s (last 5m). Trigger: anomaly-detector-v2. Auto-page to oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/streaming/p99?from=now-15m
alex: I'm on call — looking at kvcache hit rate and routing. @sara can you confirm any recent rollouts?
sara: checking — kvcache hit rate dropped from ~92% -> ~45% around 7265439600. logs show repeated `kv_cache_get: timeout` and a spike in `kv_cache_miss`
james: customer-side: no 5xx flood, but streaming tail latency shows big variance. p95 ok, p99 blown out. which clusters impacted?
leo: eu-west-1 and us-east-1 show correlated spikes. routing shows traffic bouncing to quantized vram-fallback variants. timeline matches a canary that touched kvcache eviction rules.
maya: I deployed a small kvcache tweak this morning (deploy/2026-03-17-kv-opt). Possible regression. I'm reverting now.
alex: Rolling back canary: `deploy rollback deploy/2026-03-17-kv-opt` — initiating. Will also temporarily enable warm pool fallback routing.
incident-bot: ACTION: page escalated to SRE rotation. Recommended mitigations: 1) rollback canary 2) route latency-fallback -> warm pool 3) increase streaming quota for affected customers to avoid queueing.
sara: rollback finished ~2m. kvcache hit rate recovering 45% -> 88% within 2m. p99 trending down to 1.12s.
james: CS notified to watch for customer reports. So far only isolated retries seen, no large-scale errors.
leo: checking node health: no OOMs after rollback. logs confirm kv timeouts stopped. tailwatch running for 30m.
maya: running smoke test against streaming endpoints with `curl -N` to ensure no stalls. will report results in 5m.
alex: quick triage checklist I ran: ```1) grafana query: sum(rate(kv_cache_hit[1m]))/sum(rate(kv_cache_requests[1m])) 2) consumer lag: kafka.consumer_lag{topic="streaming"} 3) node events: kubectl get events --namespace=runtime | grep -i oom 4) routing: routectl get-policies --service=streaming``` follow-up: create RCA ticket for deploy/2026-03-17-kv-opt and add rollout guard on kvcache hit-rate drop.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident page created -> https://incidents.redwood.ai/7265439999 (auto). Severity: S2 (latency regression, customer impact potential).
sara: smoke looks good — no stalls, p99 at 0.98s on canary traffic after rollback verification.
leo: plan: keep warm-pool routing for 10m, if p99 < 1s for 10m we'll fully clear. otherwise escalate to deep-engineering.
maya: smoke success: streaming chunk delivery stable, no chunk timeouts seen.
alex: updating incident page with timeline + mitigation. assigning RCA to maya + sara + leo. Will post postmortem if follow-up needed. :thumbsup: 
james: thanks team — will stand down paging if stable for 15m and no customer reports.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: automatic monitoring shows p99 back under alert threshold for 8m. Closing auto-page if no further regressions.
